tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search Danish companies in the CVR read model (read-only). Filters include industry, size, municipality (kommune), city/postnummer and region. Prefer exclude_reklamebeskyttelse=true for marketing leads.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get one company snapshot by 8-digit CVR number (read-only).

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: Get structured financial history for one CVR (read-only).

tools.name: recommend_leads
tools.description: Ranked lead shortlist from CVR filters (read-only). Scores the 500 highest-revenue matches (revenue, employees, email, phone) and returns them best first; page with limit and offset. Includes GDPR contact warnings.

tools.name: get_data_dictionary
tools.description: Static documentation for the CVR read model and tool usage rules (no database writes).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: recommend_leads · Private data: recommend_leads, get_data_dictionary · Public sink: recommend_leads.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: recommend_leads · Private data: recommend_leads, get_data_dictionary · Public sink: recommend_leads

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
